watches.name: Octane Chronograph
watches.description: A sporty and stylish chronograph watch with a tachymeter. Perfect for the modern man who values precision and style. Features a stainless steel case and a durable leather strap.

watches.name: G-Shock DW-5600E
watches.description: The quintessential tough watch. The G-Shock is known for its extreme durability, shock resistance, and 200m water resistance. A classic digital watch for any adventure.

watches.name: Grant Chronograph Brown Leather
watches.description: Inspired by vintage timepieces, the Grant watch has a classic appeal. Roman numerals and a timeless chronograph eyelet make it a sophisticated choice for any occasion.

watches.name: Seiko 5 Automatic
watches.description: A legendary automatic watch known for its reliability and value. Features a transparent case back to view the intricate automatic movement. A perfect first mechanical watch.

watches.name: ColorFit Pro 4
watches.description: India's leading smartwatch. Features a large, bright display, Bluetooth calling, and a comprehensive suite of health tracking features including heart rate, SpO2, and sleep monitoring.

watches.name: Weekender Analog
watches.description: A simple, versatile, and classic field watch. Known for its clean dial and Indiglo backlight, making it easy to read in any light. The interchangeable strap lets you customize your look.

watches.name: Trendies Analog Watch
watches.description: A fun and vibrant watch for the youth. Features a quirky dial design and a comfortable silicone strap, perfect for daily casual wear.

watches.name: Eco-Drive Promaster
watches.description: The professional's choice. Powered by any light with Eco-Drive technology, this diver's watch never needs a battery. Built for adventure with 200m water resistance.

watches.name: Apple Watch SE
watches.description: All the essentials to help you be motivated and active, stay connected, track your health, and stay safe. A great-value entry into the Apple Watch ecosystem.

watches.name: Galaxy Watch 6 Classic
watches.description: A timeless design with a rotating bezel for easy app navigation. Advanced health monitoring with a BioActive Sensor to track ECG and blood pressure.

watches.name: Forerunner 255
watches.description: The ultimate GPS running smartwatch. Get training reports, track your recovery, and get a complete picture of your health, from sleep to training.

watches.name: PRX Powermatic 80
watches.description: A modern re-issue of a classic 1970s design. Features an integrated bracelet and a stunning waffle-pattern dial. The Powermatic 80 movement offers an 80-hour power reserve.

watches.name: Parker Pavé Gold-Tone Watch
watches.description: A glamorous and sophisticated timepiece. The gold-tone stainless steel is complemented by a sparkling pavé-studded bezel for an elegant, uptown sensibility.

watches.name: Classic Petite Melrose
watches.description: An icon of minimalist design. The Classic Petite features a contemporary mesh strap and a clean, simple dial that is effortlessly elegant.

watches.name: Luigi Chronograph
watches.description: Sleek and refined, this Emporio Armani watch features a bold black dial with silver-tone accents and a comfortable stainless steel mesh bracelet.

watches.name: Bambino Version 4
watches.description: A highly-acclaimed dress watch with a classic domed crystal and a beautiful sunburst dial. Powered by a reliable in-house Japanese automatic movement.

watches.name: Captain Cook Automatic
watches.description: A reissue of a 1962 classic, the Captain Cook is a stunning vintage-inspired diver. Features a high-tech ceramic bezel and a powerful automatic movement.

watches.name: HydroConquest Automatic
watches.description: A high-performance dive watch combining technical innovation and elegance. The HydroConquest is a benchmark for Swiss-made sports watches.

watches.name: Vintage A168WA
watches.description: The iconic retro digital watch. A timeless design that has been popular for decades, featuring a stopwatch, alarm, and an electroluminescent backlight.

watches.name: Raga Viva Rose Gold
watches.description: An elegant timepiece for women, inspired by modern femininity. The rose gold bracelet and Swarovski crystal-studded dial make it a beautiful accessory.

watches.name: Superfibre Digital Watch
watches.description: A highly functional and durable digital watch from Tata. Perfect for sports and outdoor activities with its tough fibre strap and multiple features.

watches.name: Bank Blue Dial Watch
watches.description: A classic, preppy design that reflects the Tommy Hilfiger brand. The blue dial with a day-date function is both stylish and practical.

watches.name: Charge 6
watches.description: A premium fitness tracker with Google essentials built-in. Track your workouts, heart rate, and sleep, and stay connected with Google Maps, Wallet, and YouTube Music controls.

watches.name: Seamaster Diver 300M
watches.description: The legendary James Bond watch. A true icon in the watch world, featuring a distinctive wave-pattern dial, a ceramic bezel, and a Master Chronometer movement.

watches.name: Submariner Date
watches.description: The archetypal divers' watch and a benchmark in its genre. The Rolex Submariner is an icon of watchmaking, instantly recognizable and universally admired.

watches.name: Edifice Chronograph
watches.description: Speed and intelligence. A high-performance metal chronograph from Casio with a dynamic design and advanced features, inspired by motorsport.

watches.name: Presage 'Cocktail Time'
watches.description: Inspired by the glamour of a cocktail bar, this Seiko Presage features a stunning textured dial that radiates with beauty. A sophisticated automatic dress watch.

watches.name: Amazfit GTR 4
watches.description: A premium GPS smartwatch with a classic design. Features strong and precise GPS tracking, a large AMOLED display, and an ultra-long battery life.

watches.name: Hugo Boss Integrity
watches.description: A contemporary watch with a minimalist aesthetic. The blue sunray dial is complemented by a stainless steel mesh bracelet for a refined, modern look.

watches.name: Fossil Gen 6 Smartwatch
watches.description: The perfect blend of fashion and tech. Powered by Wear OS by Google, this smartwatch offers faster performance, SpO2 tracking, and smart battery modes.

watches.name: Skagen Grenen Solar
watches.description: A testament to Danish minimalist design and sustainability. This watch features a solar-powered movement and a case made from at least 50% recycled stainless steel.

watches.name: Police To Be The King
watches.description: A bold and rebellious timepiece. The black dial features a prominent skull motif, making a strong style statement. For those who dare to be different.

watches.name: Titan Edge Ceramic
watches.description: One of the slimmest watches in the world. The Titan Edge is a marvel of engineering, featuring an ultra-thin movement housed in a sleek, high-tech ceramic case.

watches.name: Apple Watch Ultra 2
watches.description: The most rugged and capable Apple Watch ever. Designed for endurance athletes and adventurers, with a titanium case, precision dual-frequency GPS, and up to 36 hours of battery life.

watches.name: HMT Pilot
watches.description: A piece of Indian watchmaking history. The HMT Pilot is a legendary hand-winding mechanical watch, cherished by collectors for its simplicity, reliability, and vintage charm.
